preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of constraints m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n for li, ri, _ in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint must specify valid indices li and ri within the range of the array.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= qi < 2**30 for _, _, qi in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint's qi value must be a non-negative integer less than 2^30.

postconditions.description: If an interesting array exists, the output must start with 'YES' followed by the array of n integers.
If no interesting array exists, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((array[li-1] & array[ri-1]) == qi for li, ri, qi in constraints)
postconditions.description: For each constraint, the bitwise AND of the specified range must equal qi.
